land.title: Land tenure
land.intro: Each colour shows who holds the land, not whether you may enter it. Crossing private land is up to its owner.
land.caveat: Land Council freehold can show as private land. Roads, waterways and public areas aren't properly mapped around Sydney and Wollongong.
land.credit: Land: NSW Land Tenure, December 2024 v2 © State of New South Wales (Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development), CC BY 4.0

fire.title: Fire history
fire.intro: Each area is coloured by how long since it last burnt: darkest within the year, fading out by 10 years. Older fires and ground with no recorded fire have no colour.
fire.caveat: Mapped by NSW National Parks and Wildlife Service: a fire it didn't map, often on private land, has no colour.
fire.credit: Fire history © State Government of NSW and NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water 2010 — NPWS Fire History - Wildfires and Prescribed Burns (CC BY 4.0)

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.intro: Hatching marks where your carrier's own model predicts no mobile reception for a phone in your hand outdoors.
coverage.caveat: It's a prediction, and valley and canyon floors are where it's most often wrong. A reseller on Telstra's network may get less than Telstra's own.
coverage.credit: Mobile coverage: ACCC Mobile Infrastructure Report data release © Commonwealth of Australia (ACCC), CC BY 2.5 AU; coastline © ABS, CC BY 4.0
